en: Color postcard showing a landscaped central square with flowerbeds, paths and benches, a central fountain and a white column/monument. Along the edge are low historic buildings, and a tall‑spire Gothic church dominates the scene. Romanian postage and cancellations are present. The back has handwritten Romanian text dated 05.05.80 from Dej and is addressed to Ploiești, Romania.
